name: x-watcher
description: Modular X monitoring agent: daily digests and reset alerts

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js demo
scripts.start: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js run
scripts.config:check: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js config
scripts.watch: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js watch
scripts.x:probe: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js x:probe
scripts.x:preview: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js x:preview
scripts.source:probe: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js source:probe
scripts.source:preview: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js source:preview
scripts.rsshub:probe: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js rsshub:probe
scripts.rsshub:preview: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js rsshub:preview
scripts.mail:status: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js mail:status
scripts.mail:resolve: npm run build && node --experimental-sqlite --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli.js mail:resolve
